svg.aria-label: Detection pipeline: the Cisco network, OPNsense and Suricata, the Windows domain, Proxmox and Docker, and UniFi send logs to Wazuh, which decodes, correlates and responds, then forwards events to Splunk for search and dashboards. A brute force on SWAGGER-DC-01 is caught, Wazuh raises a level 10 alert and an active response blocks the source.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
